perspectives.brief: Games can be good without lasting forever. Games can excel by doing a few things well. Treating difficulty as part of a game is important. Passion and love in game development is key to a good game. Games can be enjoyable without complex progression systems.
perspectives.detail:
Game Quality argues that Games can be good without lasting forever. Games can excel by doing a few things well. Treating difficulty as part of a game is important. Passion and love in game development is key to a good game. Games can be enjoyable without complex progression systems.

The posts defend it in their own words. @dominictarason.com writes, “Onirism will likely always have some rough edges, because it is by a small indie team, and the game is simultaneously Serious Sam, Blood, Call of Duty Zombies, Bioshock, Timesplitters, Halo, Star Wars Battlefront and every PS2-era mascot platformer ever made.” @spyre.hoot.gay writes, “I’m feeling thoroughly frustrated with gaming discourse. I have so many thoughts brewing in my mind about how people talk about video games these days. So many thoughts.” @nerdysasquatch.bsky.social writes, “Sure, most of them weren't that great, but every so often you had a gem like DuckTales NES and Goldeneye 64 that made it worth it and so many shows in the past decade could have produced some really fun and good games.”

Inside Game Quality, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

perspectives.title: Data Centers Harm
perspectives.summary: Data centers harm communities and environment

representative_posts.author: dnumde.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Fuck data centers! It's a manufactured distraction. #StopStealingMyData Pass a law to stop tech from stealing DATA and information and clawback that data plus #reparations for DAS citizens. #ThisIsAmerica

representative_posts.author: dalishbandit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ll say it again: Data centers built to accommodate AI usage are contributing to habitat loss, climate change, access to clean water and they are destroying communities many of them already marginalized communities.

representative_posts.author: informationbank.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Here's why data centers are so opposed in many communities.

representative_posts.author: bluegold1026.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No more data centers! Job are not long-term and AI isn't the revolutionary concept that tech bros want to force us to believe it is. I wish people would stop focusing on the short-term benefits without considering the long-term consequences.

representative_posts.author: russiasux.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone from this needs to be addressed and preferably in places where people will see that data centers are more than just water and electricity. Need to stop them from taking over our state with this crap

representative_posts.author: marycorcoran.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Moratorium on data centres until all environmental damage is put right. Punitive damages and removal of licence to operate in jurisdictions affected. If you want #datacentres it should be of no detriment to the environment or humans. #google arrogant wreckers!

representative_posts.author: danielaldrich.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Locals have made developers drop billions of dollars in data center plans. They may have to win that fight again at the state level

representative_posts.author: peterxdunn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Data centres are integral to the control grid which the fascist elites will use to enslave humanity Data centers will poison the environment in which the enslaved live Data centers are both anti people and anti planet RESIST DATA CENTRES NO PASARAN

representative_posts.author: jacquesvanvulpen.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So that counts for data center only? In the mean time you are going on destroying them by living. Even with data centers.

representative_posts.author: borasca0107.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 🚨 AI Data Centres Doug Ford bragged about building hundreds of Data Centres in Ontario! He's building around 10 of them between Vaughn & Hamilton, now - TEN AI Data Centres! AND .. already, from Nov. 1st, Ontario will be buying power from the NEW YORK STATE Whatever his excuse, it's for DATA

representative_posts.author: economymedicine.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: A lot of the proposed hyper scale data centers are not going to happen or will end up much smaller not just because of local opposition. Supply chain and ability to monetize things is going to be a bit drag especially for projects only in the planning stages.

representative_posts.author: gingerjet.net
representative_posts.text: I visited a number of data centers in LA a few months ago including one in Vernon and across the street was a paper mill and a block away a metal fabrication company. Both orders of magnitude more harmful to the environment than any data center in the area.

representative_posts.author: janenorman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: HOW THE GRASSROOTS IS FIGHTING BACK AGAINST BIG DATA CENTERS: Our went to Pennsylvania to talk to voters fed up with the arrival of giant data centers next door DC

representative_posts.author: chanl1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Come on Larry, why don't you just tell the Truth! BlackRock has placed its investment bet, heavily in AI & data Centers! Every day in delay of buildings' completion = cost going up! Just tell the American people, if 🇺🇸 don't have those Data Centers, American leadership will be lost to 🇨🇳 & 🇮🇳!

representative_posts.author: niamluap.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Data centres in the west need to be cleaned of bot farms. They should be made illegal and the owners sent to prison. What people put on servers cannot be an excuse.

representative_posts.author: climatebrad.hillheat.com
representative_posts.text: "Another worry: the increasing number of data centers that are being delayed by permitting issues, and in some instances falling through."

representative_posts.author: thedoodle0503.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The reckless expansion of mega data centers has gone unchecked for too long. An immediate halt on approvals for new mega data centres is the circuit breaker we urgently need. Sign the petition to protect our water and energy, and force Big Tech to put people before profits:

representative_posts.author: wojtekborowicz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So all the 'We're building out INFINITY DOLLARS worth of data centres to satisfy demand' and 'oh yeah?? Well we're building INFINITY TIMES TWO DOLLARS worth!' was just make-believe? Shocking, I tell you. Who knew.

representative_posts.author: wiartonwilly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Why does it have to be abundant data centres? Can’t we just have abundant food, water and shelter?

representative_posts.author: jta51.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: People don’t understand Data Centers, they do understand the outrageous increases in auto and home insurance and the collusion of Republicans with the insurance industry. Dems should be using that.

representative_posts.author: cpj1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You wonder how this shit even gets by a zoning board. The other problem is, once this data center goes bankrupt five or ten years down the road; nobody is going to want to develop that property. It's not like a warehouse structure that could be turned into a shopping center.

representative_posts.author: sapphixy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: does that remind you of all the money poured into data centers based on empty promises of what the gigantic machine learning models might one day possibly hypothetically do? by comparison the dot com bubble seems like a reasonable sort of speculation bubble

representative_posts.author: gregwritesinvt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I keep thinking about how vital it is for so many tech companies to harvest and sell our data because otherwise they wouldn’t exist because the product or service they offer isn’t something most of us would pay for, and certainly wouldn’t pay what it costs for them to function.

representative_posts.author: organicbotanic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: A children’s story? “What is a Data Center?,” follows honey badger “Honey” getting guided tour of data center from worker Oliver, Who explains job of data center employees is to make sure that the “functions supported by the data center” are available to anybody, “no matter what time it is.” #AI

representative_posts.author: imgregory.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: They need the DATA CENTERS in order to control us. We can NOT let them do that. Halt the data centers, close them down. Convert them into regional battery storage for the electric grid DO IT NOW!

representative_posts.author: anondeplume.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Fuck these billionaire dipshits. If Bezos thinks that AI will conquer all, the motherfucker had better think on.Because all it will do is create massive division. Resulting in an all out war against AI. And the follow on effect of that will be the destruction of Data Centers by any means necessary.

representative_posts.author: judgement-bot.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Before utilities build dirty peaker plants for AI data centers, a simple motor throttle could free up gigawatts hiding in plain sight. Evidence: Systemic Conservation, Grid Relief, Tech Hyperscaler Offsetting #Energy #Tech

representative_posts.author: tryangregory.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Ok but have we tried more pipelines and data centres?

representative_posts.author: irishicesp.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How the fuck did the people of SUOMI allow Google to purchase the land. What did they think was going to happen? The data center revolution is not a secret. Where are your citizens? BAN DATA CENTERS.

representative_posts.author: techwizard.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Google next month: "We have updated our terms of service to scan your emails and photos for bank information to send ourselves a nice little gift" I guess they got to pay for all that AI data center build out some how...

representative_posts.author: ukrainee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 🇺🇦🤜🇷🇺Russian data centers are falling like dominoes. 🎯 ​ Over the weekend, the Federal Tax Service data center in Gorodets got hit—taking down half of Russia’s primary tax database and state registry infrastructure. ​ That’s TWO mega data centers down in 9 days.

representative_posts.text: to acknowledge some unfun nuance here: 1. I trust Ukrainian military reasons for targeting that data center, I just figure it's more complex than the story above that appeals to us 2. Data centers are clearly infrastructure targets. US having these in every town is using us as civilians nearby... 🤔

representative_posts.text: This warrants a criminal investigation. A MAGA-owned American data centre is the last thing Nova Scotia should be building. Vichie & Houston pitched a "green hydrogen" scam 3 years ago when those were fashionable. That same scam has now become a data centre scam.

representative_posts.author: romston.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Good morning, beautiful Mel! Happy Friday, dear friend! I love the angle you gave to this photography. The sun caresses those tree branches; we can feel the love between the sun and the trees. We can almost feel the calm wind. Thank you for the light you share with us. I wish you a beautiful day! 🫂🩵

representative_posts.author: daddysden.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Good morning to all you extremely lovely people out there. Remember to drink water today, take the time to give yourself a compliment, and most important of all BE YOURSELF. You’re gonna crush today and if it turns out to be a challenge, remember there are people here who care about you. 💚
